scopeAuthority: Owner planning request October 17, 2026, including in-app feedback extension. No live activation authority.

criteria.requirement: Exhaustive health states render with explicit warning tone and words.
Calendar-aware freshness distinguishes stale, paused, never-run and failure.
Bounded history queries and typed diagnostics preserve useful cause without secret or personal data.
Backup capture, upload, integrity, pruning and media outcomes have distinct persisted evidence.
Private store readiness and linked media copies are verified without exposing credentials.
Safe retention, retry and tombstone behavior survive a disposable real restore.
Standard OAuth PKCE connection and refresh preserve selected authority.
Revocation, downgrade, token replay and metadata SSRF attacks are refused.
Existing login and account isolation remain intact; auth secrets excluded from recovery.
Direct SDK transport can discover and call safe diagnostic tools with consistent guards.
Bounded result handles isolate callers and recheck revoked authority.
Compatible server upgrade preserves connection; catalog budget and schema-version errors are tested.
Preview and actual execution enforce current delegation, target versions and optional approval.
Concurrent replay, target conflict, budget reservation and fenced workers produce one authorized effect.
Crash and uncertain provider results reconcile without blind duplicate execution; readback is honest.
Repair cases preserve source issue, expected result and sanitized evidence.
Foreign/fabricated engineering evidence is rejected; PR, merge, deploy and verification stay separate.
Issue resolution follows actual verification and preserves rollback/domain restrictions.
Signed-in reporters submit and track private bug or improvement reports without cross-account access.
Screenshot/context pipeline strips sensitive metadata and enforces safe upload authorization and limits.
AI opt-in, withdrawal, privacy export/deletion and restore suppression cover all report content.
Agent tools enforce support scopes, report AI permission and internal/reporter separation.
Reports support private conversation, duplicate/case links, evidence-backed resolution and reporter reopen.
Prompt injection and withdrawn consent cannot authorize new actions or leak derived private content.
Stored schedules, leases, cursors, cooldown and outbox survive restart and overlapping workers.
Owner-selected delegation permits supported actions and revocation stops queued execution.
Heartbeat and external-worker status are truthful; notification retry does not duplicate or recurse.
Bounded aggregate observations carry baseline, sample and provenance without sensitive dimensions.
Improvement proposals include verification, risk and rollback without silently executing changes.
All in-scope maintenance/settings controls have tested tools or a genuine provider-required handoff.
RTC doors conform to pinned upstream contract and use the same native authorization as direct MCP.
Two-process shared-database limits, pass lifecycle, result ownership and leak probes pass.
Declared clients, compatible redeploy and optional Hub routes have truthful individually recorded evidence.
